ambient_events: The fountains drop for a second, then come back up.
Somebody sits on the edge of the basin and eats a hot dog over the water.
A groundskeeper picks ticket stubs out of a hedge one at a time.
description: Hughson Gardens, the east fountain, the twin of the one across Grandstand Walk: a limestone basin, two tiers and a gilt sun, jets arching in from the rim and yews at the corners. The benches face the water, not the Coliseum.
name: Hughson Gardens
